title: 100 additional local jurisdictions
method: All 74 already-scoped jurisdictions are excluded, including the 30 outstanding collection targets. Wave 1 fills the Census top-50 gaps. Wave 2 adds one anchor in each state still absent after wave 1. Wave 3 adds county layers and selected secondary cities. Sequence within each wave orders matched Census place populations descending; counties follow because comparable city populations are not assigned. This is an editorial coverage recommendation, not a numerical estimate of legal importance or extraction difficulty.
limits: Scope representation is not completed full-text collection or statewide local-law coverage.
Population is a scale indicator, not a count of affected employers or a non-overlapping coverage total.
County and combined-government populations are intentionally not substituted with city-only Census figures.
Source discovery is not live acquisition validation. Existing scripts require qualification on each new target.
Territories, tribal governments and special districts are outside this 100-target recommendation.
DC is excluded as a new local target because the October 16 inventory already maps its code and regulations in the state-level workflows.

sources.purpose: October 16 cross-check: same 74 local jurisdictions; DC statutes/regulations mapped in state workstreams
